capability.description_evidence: A clean-context architecture-rules subagent inspected the plan, repository contracts, runtime scripts, skills, and schemas for this refactor.
capability.name: delegated-scoped-project-architecture-rules-subagent

rules.summary: Human Markdown is durable review state; STATUS.md is generated and machine/runtime evidence lives only under _kapelle/.
Each logical artifact has one physical path; recovery reports evidence honestly and never fabricates approval, validation, review, or historical telemetry.
Recovered coordination graphs are provisional: validation-only is allowed for existing work, but code-writing, feature review, and ship require refreshed architecture guidance and decomposition.
Validation and review freshness covers human documents, normalized coordination graphs, and the actual implementation files.
Migration performs complete preflight before mutation and writes its success marker only after rebuilt-state validation.
Utilities are deterministic and local: no shell, network, git mutation, or provider-specific routing.
